direction: Longer fixed-horizon B0 matched spot-long/perp-short carry
hypothesis: Reduce repeated execution friction relative to earlier8/24/48hour carry while accruing actual funding. Do not forecast or amplify positive funding.

time_boundaries.training: No model/labels/fitting.21days cost warmup plus3day initial gap;fixed rules and grid throughout.

rule.entry: At each completed hourly signal T when flat and a whole H-hour horizon fits before scheduled end, force B0 entry. Known NAV is sampled after funding through T; quantity=floor(fraction*knownNAV/known spot close/commonlot)*commonlot. Funding in T..T+1minute settles old positions before execution but cannot influence sizing.
rule.exit: Fixed entry signal+H hours at next minute open; next hourly decision may re-enter. Costed terminal exit; no fold resets.
rule.weights: Fraction is raw notional/NAV PER LEG,not cash allocation or normalized portfolio weight; gross about2*f. Initial spotcash5000/perpcollateral5000,total10000. Exact matched base quantity; no transfers,rebalancing or borrow.
rule.funding: Actual rate*actual settlement mark*old matched quantity; actual settlement and availability ns retained; forecast feature debug only,B0 does not select on it.
rule.margin: Original1% hourly mark-high envelope plus independent pre/post-event whole-hour mark-high check and isolated cash checks. Conservative complete in-OOS hourly bounds can include pre-entry/post-exit extremes;terminal gap uses closed-minute traded-high proxy,never post-OOS mark high. Qualification only,never signals. No automatic liquidation model;any violation rejects.

costs.impact: 0.5*strictly previous20complete-day log-return sample sigma*sqrt(leg quote notional/leg prior20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_stress: Paid negative receipts multiplied; positive income unchanged; actual settlement mark and millisecond jitter retained.
costs.metadata: Frozen20261001spot snapshot plus normalized perp metadata; historical proxy,not refreshed historical tiers.
costs.borrow: No spot short or borrowing; USDT yield0; isolated5000/5000books,no transfers.

sources.scope: Original real minute spot/perp and hourly mark archive provenance; normalized ns hashes checked.
Actual realized rates,settlement marks/timestamps. Official page redirects to current market-data catalog.
Existing unchanged isolated-ledger B0 engine and floating-quantity accounting;new horizon/fraction/OOS only.

history_note: Reused2025-2026development history,not untouched finalholdout. Prior B0/B1 real results retained; no exact old configuration rerun. Many prior trials;no DSR/PBO claim.
limits: No historical L2/TCA or exchange liquidation tiers;frozen metadata and1%maintenance are declared proxies.
Original hourly equity retained;stronger full closed-minute traded-price plus post-fill NAV reconstructed independently;not minute mark-price NAV/intraminute extrema.
No real orders or changes to originalSMA orpaper10 accounts.
